about.text: A soft cheese from northern Benin, made by women and mostly by the Peulh (Fulani). Fresh whole cow's milk is heated and curdled with an extract of the Sodom apple plant (Calotropis procera), whose enzyme does the work of rennet. The curd drains in small colanders. Some cheeses are dyed red with sorghum.

facts.v: Eaten fried or raw, sold in markets and at waakye stalls, mostly in the north and Volta regions
Made by Peul women in the north, where it is counted a luxury food
